source.title: On Dreaded Wings
source.description:
A shredded wing of the Dread Lord Balnazzar is all that remains of the toppled Nathrezim.

Someone at Light's Hope may be interested in this.
source.objective: Take the Wing of Balnazzar to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
source.completion:
A fellow trophy lover!? Grok'lo have large collection himself.

Nothing bring Grok'lo den together like skull of his enemy.

<Grok'lo Laughs>

What you got? Giant Bat wing? Mok'lo seen before. Not impressive anymore. Better as bow or sold for coin than a trophy.

If you like, bring Grok'lo a string and Grok'lo arrange a meeting with his special crafter.
